review_locator: PMCID:PMC4174316, Complex Interactions of Transcription Factors in Mediating Cytokine Biology in T Cells; PMCID:PMC3579502, Transcriptional regulation of follicular T-helper (Tfh) cells
primary_title: BATF-JUN is critical for IRF4-mediated transcription in T cells
decision_basis: The review identifies cooperative BATF/Jun and IRF4 binding at the Il21 promoter in Th17 cells; the cited primary demonstrates co-localized IRF4, BATF and Jun occupancy at the Il21 locus in IL-21-stimulated CD4-positive T cells and Th17 cells within an IL-21-regulated transcriptional program.
limitations_preserved: Direct locus co-occupancy and cooperative transcriptional context support a bounded IL21 gene-regulation edge; this does not establish IL-21 protein secretion, IL21R signaling, SCI relevance, or terminal-TF output.
